description.value:
Maximum HP +8. Your memosprite's Skill grants all allied memosprites damage +2 and you and your sprite damage +2 for 2 turns; these two grants do not double-stack on your sprite. Its disappearance restores 3 Energy, once per turn.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching remembrance Path required.
